markets.question: GRAMMYs 2024: Will ‘World Music Radio’ by Jon Batiste win Album of the Year?
markets.description:
The 66th GRAMMYs Awards Show, presented by the Recording Academy, is an event honoring “outstanding achievement in the music industry” for the period of time between October 1, 2022, to September 15, 2023. It is scheduled to take place at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles on February 4, 2024. The nominations were announced on November 10, 2023.

If ‘World Music Radio’ by Jon Batiste wins the Grammy for Album of the Year at the 66th GRAMMYs Awards Show, this market will resolve to “Yes”. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If for any reason no winner is declared by December 31, 2024, 11:59 PM ET, or in case of a tie for winner, this market will resolve in favor of the nominated album which comes first in alphabetical order.

The resolution source will be the television broadcast of the awards and the Grammy website (https://www.grammy.com/), however other credible reporting may be used.

events.title: Fact Check: Did US Refuel Israeli Aircraft in the Qatar Strike?
events.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if it is widely and credibly confirmed that the Israeli airstrike on Qatar on September 9, 2025, was conducted with aerial refueling support provided by the United States. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Official statements from the U.S. confirming participation in refueling will qualify. If no broad consensus has been reached by September 30, 2025, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source will be a consensus of credible reporting, with priority given to official statements from relevant and reputable investigative agencies.

events.title: What will be the top US Netflix movie this week?
events.description:
Netflix is expected to update its Top 10 movies list on top10.netflix.com on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, 3:00 PM ET, reflecting viewership from the previous week (Monday to Sunday).

This market will resolve based on which movie this update ranks as the #1 US Netflix movie. If multiple movies tie for #1, this market will resolve according to the movie whose listed title comes first alphabetically.

The ranking is based on total views in the United States, as reported by Netflix for US Top 10 Movies.

If the top10.netflix.com update does not occur by September 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".
